title: Clinical & Marketing Specialist – Interventional Cardiology (Brazil)
description:
About us


BrosMed is the largest balloon catheter research, development, production, and sales enterprise in China, possessing globally leading balloon catheter technology and manufacturing capabilities. Since its establishment in 2012, the company has grown to over 1,500 staffs in scale, with R&D centers, operational centers, and production bases established worldwide.


Responsibilities


-Provide on-site clinical support during interventional procedures, including PTCA, PTA, and interventional accessories, with a strong focus on coronary specialty balloons such as POT balloons, Wedge NC scoring balloons, and Alveo CTO balloons.

-Support distributors and physicians during case coverage, product demonstrations, and technical guidance in catheterization laboratories.

-Manage and develop key hospitals and key opinion leaders (KOLs) within assigned regions, ensuring continuous clinical follow-up and strong professional relationships.

-Work closely with the sales team and distributors to support regional sales objectives; proactively assist in product positioning, clinical adoption, and procedure planning.

-Participate in and support major medical congresses, workshops, live cases, and training programs, including booth support and academic promotion.

-Deliver clinical training and product education to distributors, sales representatives, and healthcare professionals.

-Collect and provide market intelligence, competitive insights, and clinical feedback from the field to support marketing and product strategy.

-Assist in the launch of new products and support post-market clinical follow-up.

-Ensure all activities comply with local regulations, company policies, and compliance standards.



Qualifications


Language proficiency:

High-level command of a local language

the ability to communicate in English for basic work-related communications (for collaboration with headquarters).

Industry background:

Relevant experience in healthcare sectors such as medical practitioners, nurses, pharmaceutical representatives, medical device/pharmaceutical distributors;

preference given to candidates familiar with local healthcare systems, distribution channels, and client needs.

Core qualities:

Passionate about sales work, goal-oriented, results-driven;

strong self-motivation and adaptability to remote work modes;

excellent communication skills and customer service awareness.

Responsibilities


-Provide on-site clinical support during interventional procedures, including PTCA, PTA, and interventional accessories, with a strong focus on coronary specialty balloons such as POT balloons, Wedge NC scoring balloons, and Alveo CTO balloons.

-Manage and develop key hospitals and key opinion leaders (KOLs) within assigned regions, ensuring continuous clinical follow-up and strong professional relationships.

Passionate about sales work, goal-oriented, results-driven;

strong self-motivation and adaptability to remote work modes;

excellent communication skills and customer service awareness.

title: Project Manager – SAP / Supply Chain
description:
We are looking for a Senior Project Manager – SAP / Supply Chain to lead and deliver SAP Supply Chain programs and projects in complex, global environments.

This role requires strong experience managing SAP initiatives (ECC and S/4HANA) , coordinating cross‑functional and multicultural teams, and driving end‑to‑end delivery across Supply Chain, Logistics, Manufacturing, and ERP landscapes .


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead SAP Supply Chain projects and programs (ECC and S/4HANA) from initiation to closure.
  • Manage scope, schedule, budget, risks, and quality across multiple workstreams.
  • Coordinate global, cross‑functional teams (IT, business, vendors, and integrators).
  • Drive delivery of SAP initiatives across Supply Chain domains (Logistics, Manufacturing, Planning, Procurement, Warehousing).
  • Act as main interface between business stakeholders and IT teams .
  • Apply project governance, PMO standards, and delivery methodologies .
  • Support SAP S/4HANA assessments, upgrades, rollouts, and transformations .
  • Manage dependencies across SAP and non‑SAP systems (Oracle, legacy platforms, integrations).
  • Oversee testing phases (SIT, UAT), cutover, go‑live, and hypercare.
  • Ensure executive‑level communication, reporting, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Contribute to portfolio management , roadmap definition, and prioritization.
  • Identify risks, resolve conflicts, and ensure successful outcomes.


Required Skills & Experience

  • Solid experience in IT Project Management , with strong focus on SAP .
  • Proven experience managing SAP Supply Chain projects/programs .
  • Solid understanding of SAP ECC and S/4HANA landscapes.
  • Experience working with global / multi‑country teams .
  • Strong knowledge of project management best practices (waterfall, agile, hybrid).
  • Experience coordinating vendors, system integrators, and offshore teams .
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent English (mandatory); Portuguese required; Spanish is a plus.


Certifications (Required or Preferred)

  • PMP® (mandatory or strong plus)
  • PMI‑ACP®, CSM®, ITIL® (nice to have)
  • SAP project or program management experience highly valued


Nice to Have

  • Experience as SAP Program Manager or Portfolio Lead .
  • Exposure to Supply Chain processes (Logistics, Manufacturing, Planning).
  • Experience with S/4HANA transformation programs .
  • Background in consumer goods, manufacturing, agribusiness, or industrial sectors .
  • PMO setup or governance model implementation experience.


Keywords for ATS

Project Manager, SAP Project Manager, SAP Program Manager, SAP Supply Chain, S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP Logistics, SAP Manufacturing, SAP SCM, Portfolio Management, PMO, PMP, Agile, Global Projects, ERP Transformation

title: Senior Fullstack Developer (Python + React)
description:
About The Company

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About The Opportunity

We're seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join our Supply Chain & Operations technology team. This is a high-impact role focused on rapid application development for business-critical systems that power clients' global supply chain, logistics, and operational excellence.

You'll work embedded within a dynamic, hybrid team of internal engineers and external collaborators, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, UX designers, and technical leads to deliver full-stack solutions that solve real operational challenges. This role requires someone who goes beyond just writing code; you'll need to understand user needs, contribute to requirements analysis, and bring strong product thinking to ensure we're building the right solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop full-stack web applications using React/TypeScript and JavaScript (frontend) and Python/FastAPI (backend) to address operational challenges in supply chain, logistics, and planning systems.
  • Build and optimize solutions for large-scale relational datasets with MySQL or PostgreSQL, ensuring query performance and data integrity.
  • Deploy and maintain containerized applications on Kubernetes, implementing infrastructure updates, connectivity enhancements, and cloud platform improvements.
  • Integrate with third-party systems, external APIs, workflow platforms, and enterprise services (IAM, authentication, etc.) while upholding security and privacy standards.
  • Apply DevSecOps practices throughout the development lifecycle, focusing on security by design, automated testing, and quality gates.
  • Support and maintain production systems, including triaging and resolving bugs, implementing enhancements, and executing planned infrastructure upgrades.


Required Qualifications

  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Proven capabilities in backend development, focusing on Python with FastAPI in the backend , including RESTful API design and asynchronous programming patterns
  • Advanced proficiency in React and TypeScript for modern frontend development, Single Page Applications (SPA), including state management, performance optimization, and accessible UI design
  • Expertise in Vue.js, PHP/Symfony, and databases (MySQL or PostgreSQL).
  • Disciplined approach to code quality and testing (unit, integration, end-to-end) with experience in Git


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Support Specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub. 


Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!



About the opportunity

As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.

﻿ This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew. 




We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?



Key Responsibilities:
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
  • Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
  • Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
  • Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
  • Customer Support
  • Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
  • Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
  • Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
  • Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
  • Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Escalation Management
  • Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
  • Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.

    • Skills & Qualifications:
    • Technical Expertise:
    • Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications.
    • Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
    • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
    • Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
    • Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
    • Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
    • Problem-solving Ability:
    • An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
    • Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
    • Communication Skills:
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
    • Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
    • Organizational Skills:
    • Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
    • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.



    Preferred Experience:
    • Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
    • Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
    • Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS).
    • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
    • Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
    • Previous work with an American company
    Education & Certifications:
    • Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
    • Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
    • Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.


    Who You Are:

    • A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
    • You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
    • Passion for helping others internally and externally 
    • Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
    • In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub.

title: Vendedor Interno
description:
Quem Somos Nós?

Somos uma das maiores fabricantes de fitas adesivas do Brasil , com um catálogo que abrange 43 famílias de produtos e mais de 1.000 itens, atendendo a diversos mercados.


Por que você deveria vir com a gente?

Aqui, desenvolvemos relacionamentos e valores em um ambiente saudável. Acreditamos no potencial das pessoas e estamos sempre abertos a novas ideias. Venha fazer parte de uma equipe que trabalha com o coração!


Requisitos:


  • Ensino superior em Administração, Marketing, Vendas ou áreas correlatas.
  • Cursos na área comercial, atendimento ao cliente ou vendas consultivas são considerados diferenciais.
  • Experiência prévia em vendas internas, televendas ou atendimento ao cliente.
  • Vivência com CRM (por exemplo: HubSpot, RD Station) e ferramentas digitais de prospecção.


Atividades:


  • Realizar contato ativo e receptivo com clientes;
  • Prospectar novos clientes;
  • Apresentar produtos e/ou serviços;
  • Negociar e fechar vendas;
  • Atualizar o CRM;
  • Trabalhar com metas.


Inclusão importa para a gente!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD).

title: Supervisor de Facilities
description:
Requisitos:

Ensino Superior Completo em Administração;

Conhecimento em pacote office;

CNH categoria B.


Responsabilidades:

Elaborar orçamento anual de acordo com os padrões estabelecidos, efetuando a análise de “orçado x realizado” e realizando as justificativas mensais das variações dos gastos, visando o cumprimento às normas e procedimentos internos de orçamento;

Acompanhamento dos Custos e Tendência + justificativa dos desvios;

Apoio na construção de Investimento e aprovação junto a Diretoria;

Acompanhar e interagir nas diversas reuniões de demandas que envolvem a área, reportando e alinhando com a coordenação direta;

Levantamento de Feedback para acompanhar e melhorar o atendimento dentro dos serviços da área.

Garantir a entrega e organização quanto as solicitações de reservas de salas, auditórios e coffee break para todas as áreas.

Supervisionar e garantir as entregas solicitadas pelos clientes dentro do prazo estipulado;

Supervisionar as necessidades de manutenções e reparos, elétrica, hidráulica, ar-condicionado, mobiliário, equipamentos etc., garantindo o acionamento dos reparos necessários com a equipe contratada e/ou chamados com o direcionamento para a área responsável;

Supervisionar os serviços terceirizados como limpeza, portaria, recepção, vigilância e etc.;

Supervisionar e garantir o controle e aquisição dos insumos necessários para atender a unidade (material de escritório, copa e cozinha, limpeza e manutenção);

Supervisionar e acompanhar o andamento e status das obras realizadas na unidade;

Report referente ao andamento e atendimento ao serviço dos contratos críticos;

Receber, supervisionar e dar a tratativa de protestos: com análise de notificações, acionamento das áreas responsáveis e acompanhamento até a resolução;

Acompanhamento e elaboração da nota de débito e rateio de custos entre áreas/unidades;

Atualizar e acompanhar normas e procedimentos internos - Facilities (Sistema / Auditoria);

Apoiar e atuar na implantação de novos procedimentos de trabalho a serem adotados em Facilities.

Atualização em plataforma para tratamento dos requisitos legais;

Renovar licenças e alvarás obrigatórios - IPTU, Alvará de Funcionamento

Supervisionar e aprovar dados no sistema de controle de destinação de resíduo;

Supervisionar e garantir as respostas e tratativas de Auditorias Internas e Externas;

Realizar a gestão operacional do processo de venda de Sucata Metálica e Eletrônica;

Controlar e apurar os indicadores e report dos dados da unidade;

Realizar a gestão da equipe, realizando as avaliações de desempenho, Plano de desenvolvimento, feedbacks e metas.

Controlar o ponto eletrônico (registro de ponto, saldo do Banco de horas e Férias)

Realizar o controle e a distribuição das atividades da equipe, acompanhando de prazo e cronograma, visando assegurar os processos de gestão da equipe;

Gerir os treinamentos disponível para o time e garantir suas execuções. Orientação aos colaboradores admitidos e/ou que necessitem de reciclagem de conceitos, manuseio de equipamentos, ou procedimentos adotados pela área

Atuar na gestão de conflitos, buscando solucionar os problemas no ambiente de trabalho - terceiros e liderados Facilities.


Benefícios:

Vale alimentação ou refeição;

Convênio médico e odontológico;

Participação nos lucros;

title: Full Stack Engineer, Brazil
description:
About Optibus:

Optibus is a unified software platform revolutionizing public transportation planning, scheduling, and operations in over 7,000 cities worldwide. Using AI, ML, and optimization algorithms, it empowers agencies to design more efficient, equitable, and sustainable transit networks, enhancing passenger access, reducing emissions, and improving driver conditions. With offices globally and a team of 350+ employees, Optibus fosters a collaborative culture centered on innovation, determination, and impact. As the first unicorn in public transportation technology, Optibus is driving the modernization of mass transit to make it the preferred choice for cities and passengers alike.


About the position (role & team):

Optibus is looking for a talented Full Stack Engineer to join our Planning R&D team in the mission of making transportation smarter and more efficient. We're seeking a mid-level engineer with a strong software development background and experience building and maintaining modern web applications.

As a Full Stack Engineer on the Planning Team, you’ll contribute to the development of features and improvements for our mass transportation planning products, collaborating with other engineers, product managers, and designers to create high-quality, user-focused solutions.


Responsibilities :

  • Develop, deploy, and maintain full-stack applications using React, TypeScript in the frontend, and Node.js with TypeScript deployed on K8S in the backend
  • Actively participate in the entire development lifecycle, engaging in technical discussions
  • Collaborate with the Product Manager and Designer to deliver robust, scalable features.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of full-stack web development
  • Experience with React client-side development
  • Experience with Node.js server-side development
  • Understanding of web application architecture
  • Familiarity with relational or NoSQL DBs (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in computer science or a related field
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills


It would be great if you have:

  • Experience with Python
  • Experience with AWS or an alternative cloud environment
  • Experience in the mobility ecosystem
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and CI/CD processes


Optibus is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. It is our responsibility at Optibus to provide an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all. We will provide reasonable accommodations for all candidates in need of individualised support during the hiring process.

title: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SR
description:
Oportunidade: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SR


Descrição do Cargo:

Será responsável por projetar e implementar pipelines de dados robustos, utilizando DBT e tecnologias do ecossistema Google Cloud (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, LookerML, etc.). Além disso, deverá atuar com ferramentas ETL, garantindo a extração, transformação e carga de dados de forma eficiente. Será um papel essencial na estruturação de dados para análises avançadas, garantindo que os processos sejam escaláveis, seguros e otimizados.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines de dados utilizando DBT , com otimização de macros e templates.

Projetar e otimizar estruturas de dados no Google Cloud (BigQuery), garantindo eficiência e desempenho em consultas SQL.

Implementar e manter processos de ETL , garantindo qualidade e governança dos dados migrados.

Utilizar Python para desenvolver scripts de automação e transformação de dados.

Será um papel essencial na estruturação de dados para análises avançadas, garantindo que os processos sejam escaláveis, seguros e otimizados.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines de dados utilizando DBT , com otimização de macros e templates.

Projetar e otimizar estruturas de dados no Google Cloud (BigQuery), garantindo eficiência e desempenho em consultas SQL.

Implementar e manter processos de ETL , garantindo qualidade e governança dos dados migrados.

Utilizar Python para desenvolver scripts de automação e transformação de dados.

title: Science and Healthcare Journalist (Paid Consultancy Opportunity)
description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specializing in business, healthcare, and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association, and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).



About - We are looking for media professionals who are familiar with the healthcare and life science industry for a paid consultancy section.


Qualifications:

  • Familiar with producing news/content regarding healthcare, life science, and the pharmaceutical industry.
  • The purpose of this study is to gather healthcare perceptions from industry experts.
  • The paid consultancy session will be conducted as an online survey , lasting around 15 minutes.


Compensation package - USD $90 for 15 minutes online survey

title: Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer

(Mid–Senior Level)

12 month contract

Remote


Overview

We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer to design, build, and deploy production-grade ML models while supporting the backend infrastructure required to run them at scale. This is a hands-on role combining applied machine learning, cloud engineering, and data pipeline development, with a strong focus on AI Content Moderation and Recommendation Engine systems.


Key Responsibilities


Take ownership of end-to-end ML production deployment, building and shipping new models largely from scratch, with responsibility for architecture, deployment pipelines, and operational reliability in collaboration with backend engineering.


  • Design, train, deploy, and maintain machine learning models for production use, including AI Content Moderation and Recommendation Engine features
  • Build and integrate backend infrastructure to support ML models and data pipelines
  • Work with cloud-based systems to manage model training, deployment, and monitoring
  • Improve data ingestion pipelines and feature engineering processes
  • Develop scalable, reliable ML services in collaboration with backend engineering
  • Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to gather requirements and deliver solutions
  • Communicate progress proactively and contribute to technical decision-making


Required Experience

  • 3+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI-related roles
  • Strong Python proficiency for ML development and data processing
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying ML models into production environments
  • 2+ years of practical experience working with AWS infrastructure
  • Solid background in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related technical discipline


Required Technical Skills

  • Python (advanced)
  • Production ML model development and training
  • Experience building content moderation systems and/or recommendation engines
  • AWS (deployment and infrastructure management), including:
  • AWS Lambda
  • AWS SQS
  • AWS DynamoDB
  • AWS Kinesis or Kafka
  • Experience with at least one ML framework:
  • PyTorch or TensorFlow

title: Atendente de E commerce (L1) – Marketplaces
description:
Local: Presencial - Região da Paulista

Regime: CLT

Horário: Comercial - 5x2


Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Atendente de E‑commerce (Nível 1) para atuar diretamente no atendimento aos clientes em marketplaces como Shopee, Mercado Livre, TikTok Shop e outros canais digitais .


Este profissional será responsável por garantir uma experiência positiva ao cliente, oferecendo suporte eficiente, cordial e alinhado às políticas da empresa.


Responsabilidades

  • Atender clientes via chat, e-mail e mensagens nos principais marketplaces.
  • Responder dúvidas gerais: produtos, prazos, formas de envio, políticas e status do pedido.
  • Auxiliar clientes na criação, acompanhamento, cancelamento e atualização de pedidos.
  • Tratar solicitações de troca, devolução e reembolso.
  • Registrar interações no sistema seguindo scripts e procedimentos internos.
  • Monitorar e responder avaliações e mensagens em todas as plataformas.
  • Identificar e relatar problemas recorrentes, como divergências de pedido, atrasos logísticos ou itens danificados, escalando corretamente para o time L2/Operações.
  • Apresentar promoções, campanhas e oportunidades ao cliente.
  • Encaminhar solicitações que exigem análise profunda para as equipes responsáveis.


Requisitos

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Experiência prévia com e-commerce ou atendimento ao cliente é desejável.
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal em Português.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente dinâmico e com múltiplos atendimentos simultâneos.
  • Organização, foco e agilidade.
  • Inglês é um diferencial.


Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Experiência com Shopee, Mercado Livre ou TikTok Shop.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM, OMS ou ERPs.
  • Conhecimento básico de logística e políticas de marketplaces.


Benefícios

  • Vale‑refeição
  • Vale‑transporte
  • Plano de saúde (conforme política interna).
  • Plano odontológico (opcional).


Por que trabalhar conosco?

Somos uma empresa em crescimento, com forte presença em marketplaces e foco na qualidade da experiência do cliente.


Valorizamos pessoas comprometidas, comunicativas e com vontade de evoluir profissionalmente no universo do e-commerce.

title: SAP MM/WM Senior Consultant
description:
SAP MM/WM Senior Consultant (12 month Project)


Functional expert in materials management and warehouse optimization.

Experience : 5 to 10+ years in SAP with a focus on complete implementations and ECC migrations.

title: Tech Lead | Marketplace
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Tech Lead para evoluir um Marketplace digital de plataforma, com impacto direto na expansão do ecossistema, na geração de valor e na experiência dos clientes.

O desafio envolve evoluir uma plataforma de produtos digitais integrada, escalável e orientada a crescimento. Como Tech Lead, você terá papel central em transformar visão de produto em soluções técnicas sustentáveis e prontas para escala.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Liderar tecnicamente a evolução de produtos de plataforma, garantindo qualidade, consistência e performance.
  • Definir e sustentar arquitetura, equilibrando integração, autonomia e experiência unificada.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e contribuir hands-on com o time.
  • Trabalhar próximo a produto e stakeholders, apoiando decisões e trade-offs técnicos.
  • Mentorar e desenvolver o time, promovendo boas práticas e excelência técnica.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial no dia a dia de engenharia para apoio em diagnóstico de problemas, revisão de código, documentação técnica e aceleração de entregas, garantindo uso responsável e seguro das informações.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES


  • Experiência na construção de produtos digitais de plataforma, como marketplaces, portais ou ecossistemas orientados a crescimento (PQL / PLG).
  • Forte base em arquitetura de software e sistemas distribuídos, aplicando Clean Architecture e Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Vivência sólida em backend distribuído, com microserviços em Java/Kotlin (Spring Boot), APIs REST e contratos OpenAPI.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e comunicação assíncrona, garantindo resiliência e consistência entre serviços.
  • Conhecimento em bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL) e modelagem orientada a domínio.
  • Vivência com observabilidade em sistemas distribuídos, incluindo métricas e rastreamento ponta a ponta.
  • Experiência em ambientes cloud, com CI/CD, containers e múltiplos ambientes.
  • Conhecimento de frontend moderno, incluindo React e TypeScript.
  • Atuação como Tech Lead, definindo padrões técnicos e orientando times de engenharia.
  • Experiência prévia com marketplaces digitais ou plataformas de monetização.
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade avançada, performance e escalabilidade
  • Atuação em produtos com integrações complexas e múltiplos domínios de negócio.


LOCALIDADE

Uberlândia/MG – Presencial

São Paulo/SP – Híbrido (2x/semana no escritório)

Outras localidades – Remoto

▪️ Regime de contratação: CLT

title: Sr DevOps Engineer Azure (Remoto | PJ)
description:
100% Remote

USA Timezone

Contractor / PJ position



Role Overview

The goal is to shape the reliability and scalability of mission-critical platforms on Azure, Kubernetes , and modern DevOps toolchains. You will solve complex infrastructure challenges, automate end-to-end operations, and ensure systems operate with high availability, performance, and security.


What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and improve CI/CD pipelines for applications and infrastructure
  • Develop automation frameworks that reduce manual effort and increase consistency.
  • Configure and optimize cloud infrastructure to align with security, scalability, and performance best practices.
  • Collaborate with development teams to remove deployment blockers and improve delivery workflows.
  • Monitor reliability and performance, identify issues early, and implement data-driven improvements to increase uptime and efficiency.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and drive incident resolution with clear postmortems and preventive actions.
  • Maintain technical documentation for pipelines, configurations, and runbooks.
  • Perform readiness assessments and validation tests before production rollouts.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and ARM templates with version control and reproducibility.
  • Troubleshoot complex deployment, provisioning, and performance issues across multi-cloud and containerized environments.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven track record in SRE or DevOps roles operating production systems
  • Hands-on experience running production workloads on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, including cluster design, autoscaling, upgrades, and network policies.
  • Proven CI/CD delivery using GitHub Actions or Jenkins , including promotion across environments, approvals, and rollback strategies.
  • Infrastructure as Code expertise with Terraform and ARM templates, including modules, remote state, workspaces, and policy enforcement.
  • Strong scripting in PowerShell, Bash, or Python for automation and diagnostics.
  • GitOps experience with Argo CD or Flux , managing multi-environment application delivery and drift remediation.
  • Containerization with Docker and Kubernetes , including health probes, PodDisruptionBudgets, resource quotas, HorizontalPodAutoscaler, and operators.
  • Networking fundamentals with cloud network security practices such as VNet design, NSGs, Private Link, and ingress controllers.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security and compliance, including least privilege, secrets management, audit trails, and control evidence.
  • Excellent written and spoken English .
  • Ability to collaborate across US time zone .


Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Azure certification , such as Developer Associate, Administrator, or DevOps Engineer Expert
  • Observability using Application Insights, Elastic Stack (ELK), Grafana, and Prometheus for metrics, logs, and traces.
  • Experience with log aggregation and alerting at scale using Elastic and Prometheus.
  • Understanding of high availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization strategies.
  • Experience managing Windows-based containerized applications .


Plus

  • Experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS

description:

Contractor / PJ position



Role Overview

The goal is to shape the reliability and scalability of mission-critical platforms on Azure, Kubernetes , and modern DevOps toolchains. You will solve complex infrastructure challenges, automate end-to-end operations, and ensure systems operate with high availability, performance, and security.


What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and improve CI/CD pipelines for applications and infrastructure
  • Develop automation frameworks that reduce manual effort and increase consistency.
  • Configure and optimize cloud infrastructure to align with security, scalability, and performance best practices.
  • Collaborate with development teams to remove deployment blockers and improve delivery workflows.
  • Monitor reliability and performance, identify issues early, and implement data-driven improvements to increase uptime and efficiency.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and drive incident resolution with clear postmortems and preventive actions.
  • Maintain technical documentation for pipelines, configurations, and runbooks.
  • Perform readiness assessments and validation tests before production rollouts.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and ARM templates with version control and reproducibility.
  • Troubleshoot complex deployment, provisioning, and performance issues across multi-cloud and containerized environments.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven track record in SRE or DevOps roles operating production systems
  • Hands-on experience running production workloads on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, including cluster design, autoscaling, upgrades, and network policies.
  • Proven CI/CD delivery using GitHub Actions or Jenkins , including promotion across environments, approvals, and rollback strategies.
  • Infrastructure as Code expertise with Terraform and ARM templates, including modules, remote state, workspaces, and policy enforcement.
  • Strong scripting in PowerShell, Bash, or Python for automation and diagnostics.
  • GitOps experience with Argo CD or Flux , managing multi-environment application delivery and drift remediation.
  • Containerization with Docker and Kubernetes , including health probes, PodDisruptionBudgets, resource quotas, HorizontalPodAutoscaler, and operators.
  • Networking fundamentals with cloud network security practices such as VNet design, NSGs, Private Link, and ingress controllers.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security and compliance, including least privilege, secrets management, audit trails, and control evidence.
  • Excellent written and spoken English .
  • Ability to collaborate across US time zone .


Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Azure certification , such as Developer Associate, Administrator, or DevOps Engineer Expert
  • Observability using Application Insights, Elastic Stack (ELK), Grafana, and Prometheus for metrics, logs, and traces.
  • Experience with log aggregation and alerting at scale using Elastic and Prometheus.
  • Understanding of high availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization strategies.
  • Experience managing Windows-based containerized applications .


Plus

  • Experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS

title: Data Architect (Data Modeling & Optimization)
description:
About You

You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or similar roles with a strong focus on performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora.
  • Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development.
  • Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance.
  • Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance.
  • Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora.
  • Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies.
  • Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions.
  • Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers.
  • Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments.
  • Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective.
  • Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies.
  • Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams.
  • Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: \"Analista de infraestrutura Pleno #989342\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar, identificar e solucionar problemas de conectividade em lojas, avaliando equipamentos e link;
  • Acionar parceiros de conectividade quando necessário para reestabelecer serviços;
  • Responsável por tratar os incidentes, sendo de software ou infra, das lojas de forma rápida e eficiente, seguindo os padrões definidos pelos parceiros internos e externos;
  • Atuar de forma proativa em lojas que apresentem sintomas de problemas em sua jornada de vendas;
  • Interpretar gráficos de alertas, quando indicadores saem do limite aceitável;
  • Negociar, envolver e buscar a integração do trabalho junto ao time de atendimento N1, garantindo sinergia, apoio e formação;
  • Responsável em manter a base de conhecimento e de procedimentos técnicos atualizada.


O que você precisa ter

  • Importante já ter atuado anteriormente na área de varejo;
  • Experiência em trabalhar com metodologia (ITIL e Framework Scrum);
  • Conhecimento ferramentas de gestão de TI, JIRA, TFS e Service NOW;
  • Conhecimento básico em scripts em powershell.
  • Conhecimento avançado em comandos de administração de sistema operacional Microsoft através de PowerShell ou prompt de comando;
  • Conhecimento avançado para suporte remoto em celulares Android e computadores windows;
  • Conhecimento em protocolos de rede (TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP e afins);
  • Troubleshooting em ambientes Microsoft Windows 7, Windows 10 e Windows 11.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

Conhecimento em soluções para varejo e experiência em sistemas de PDV como também conhecimento fiscal/contábil nas 3 esferas (Federal, Estadual e Municipal).


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.


Regime de contratação

CLT.

title: Video Editor
description:
About Made Simpler

Made Simpler exists to empower small and medium-sized businesses to grow smarter, stronger, and with real impact. We believe opportunity should not be defined by company size or available resources. With the right system in place, any business can compete, scale, and lead.

We are the world’s first Wholesale Marketing Agency , delivering Managed Marketing as a Service (MMaaS), a powerful combination of strategic human expertise and AI acceleration. Our model provides accessible, scalable, and results-driven marketing and revenue engines, leveling the playing field for growing businesses.

About the role

We are looking for a Video Editor with strong experience in Artificial Intelligence tools , capable of creating highly persuasive videos for Social Media, Ads, and institutional content.

This role requires the ability to balance human storytelling with AI efficiency, producing high-quality, scalable, and performance-driven video content.

This is a full time opportunity, 100% remote.

Key Responsibilities

  • Video editing and assembly: transform raw footage into polished, engaging, and cohesive narratives across multiple platforms, including social media, websites, and advertising.
  • Mastery of video editing tools: work with professional editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, and CapCut Pro (or similar).
  • AI-powered video creation: leverage generative AI platforms to create avatars, videos, and unique visual assets, with a strong focus on tools like Creatify AI.
  • Asset organization and management: maintain efficient organization of files, versions, and workflows using tools such as Notion and Google Drive.
  • Platform optimization: adapt formats, aspect ratios, codecs, and audio levels to maximize performance across platforms like Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and paid ads.

Must haves

  • Proficiency in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut Pro.
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools applied to video creation and post-production, such as Midjourney, Creatify AI, Nano Banana, Kling 3.0, Google Flow, etc.
  • Strong storytelling ability, with a solid grasp of pacing, persuasion, and visual composition.
  • Technical knowledge of video formats, codecs, compression, color correction/grading, sound design, and motion graphics.
  • Intermediate to advanced English

title: Analista de Backoffice
description:
Venha integrar um time de excelência, somos a Eyemobile uma startup que nasceu para revolucionar o varejo! ✨


Nossa missão é simplificar a forma como negócios vendem através de inovação e tecnologia.


Estamos há 12 anos no mercado, e em nossa história, temos muitos aprendizados e conquistas, que nos ajudaram a construir uma cultura sólida, com base em três pilares: o Cuidar, Imaginar e Simplificar. Tudo isso pensando em nossos clientes, parceiros, colaboradores e na tecnologia.


Se você se identifica com valores como: Simplicidade, Agilidade, Confiança, Inovação e Experiência do Cliente , já está há um passo à frente! Então, continue lendo para conhecer mais sobre essa oportunidade que pode mudar sua carreira!


➡️ Como Analista de Backoffice sua missão será atuar como ponto técnico de apoio e resolução de incidentes complexos escalados pelo time de suporte ao cliente (N1 e Parceiros), com foco em análise de dados, logs e ambiente em nuvem, tornando claro a análise realizada durante o diagnóstico.


No seu dia a dia estas serão suas responsabilidades:

  • Realizar investigações técnicas aprofundadas, atuando diretamente em bancos de dados (MySQL, PostgreSQL, etc.) e ambientes AWS, registrando causas, impactos e ações realizadas durante o processo de analise.
  • Ser responsável por identificar e diagnosticar falhas sistêmicas com agilidade e assertividade, documentando causas e ações. Garantindo alinhamento claro com stakeholders internos e comunicação estruturada para clientes.
  • Monitorar indicadores técnicos e operacionais, garantindo cumprimento de SLAs e padrões de qualidade durante a jornada do cliente.
  • Participar de atendimentos ao vivo com clientes & Parceiros via chat, vídeo ou call, trazendo clareza e segurança na comunicação técnica.
  • Atuar em conjunto com as áreas de Produto, Desenvolvimento e Operações para validar hipóteses e propor soluções permanentes e melhorias.
  • Apoiar o time de Fluxos e Processos com sugestões de melhoria em processos, fluxos e ferramentas, com foco em facilitar o atendimento e execução das atividades.
  • Produzir e manter documentação técnica, playbook e orientações para casos recorrentes ou críticos.


Para desempenhar estas atividades entendemos que você precisa ter:

  • Formação em Tecnologia da Informação, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação ou experiência equivalente.
  • Experiência comprovada em análise de banco de dados , com domínio de SQL para consultas e investigações.
  • Vivência com ambientes AWS , incluindo uso de serviços como CloudWatch, RDS, S3, Cognito, Lambda (diferenciais).
  • Experiência com troubleshooting técnico , logs, análise de erro e comportamento de sistemas em produção.
  • Conhecimento intermediário em APIs RESTful e integração entre sistemas.
  • Desejável familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento, versionamento e ticketing (como Movidesk Git, Zabbix, Freshdesk, etc.).
  • Capacidade de estruturar scripts e automações simples para análise e correção de dados (ex: Python, Shell Script).


Habilidades Pessoais Esperadas:

  • Proatividade e postura investigativa , com senso de urgência na resolução de problemas.
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva, com capacidade de explicar temas técnicos para públicos diversos.
  • Relacionamento fluido com clientes, sabendo equilibrar empatia, transparência e firmeza.
  • Organização, autonomia e comprometimento com prazos e entregas.
  • Espírito colaborativo, trabalhando bem com diferentes áreas e níveis de suporte (N1, Produto, Dev, etc.).


Mais informações:

  • Nossa contratação é como Prestador de serviços, então se faz necessário ter um CNPJ ativo.


Acha que é essa vaga é pra você? Não perca tempo e venha fazer parte da revolução do varejo com a gente! #vemsereyemaker!

➡️ Como Analista de Backoffice sua missão será atuar como ponto técnico de apoio e resolução de incidentes complexos escalados pelo time de suporte ao cliente (N1 e Parceiros), com foco em análise de dados, logs e ambiente em nuvem, tornando claro a análise realizada durante o diagnóstico.


No seu dia a dia estas serão suas responsabilidades:

  • Realizar investigações técnicas aprofundadas, atuando diretamente em bancos de dados (MySQL, PostgreSQL, etc.) e ambientes AWS, registrando causas, impactos e ações realizadas durante o processo de analise.
  • Ser responsável por identificar e diagnosticar falhas sistêmicas com agilidade e assertividade, documentando causas e ações. Garantindo alinhamento claro com stakeholders internos e comunicação estruturada para clientes.
  • Monitorar indicadores técnicos e operacionais, garantindo cumprimento de SLAs e padrões de qualidade durante a jornada do cliente.
  • Participar de atendimentos ao vivo com clientes & Parceiros via chat, vídeo ou call, trazendo clareza e segurança na comunicação técnica.
  • Atuar em conjunto com as áreas de Produto, Desenvolvimento e Operações para validar hipóteses e propor soluções permanentes e melhorias.
  • Apoiar o time de Fluxos e Processos com sugestões de melhoria em processos, fluxos e ferramentas, com foco em facilitar o atendimento e execução das atividades.
  • Produzir e manter documentação técnica, playbook e orientações para casos recorrentes ou críticos.


Para desempenhar estas atividades entendemos que você precisa ter:

  • Formação em Tecnologia da Informação, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação ou experiência equivalente.
  • Experiência comprovada em análise de banco de dados , com domínio de SQL para consultas e investigações.
  • Vivência com ambientes AWS , incluindo uso de serviços como CloudWatch, RDS, S3, Cognito, Lambda (diferenciais).
  • Experiência com troubleshooting técnico , logs, análise de erro e comportamento de sistemas em produção.
  • Conhecimento intermediário em APIs RESTful e integração entre sistemas.
  • Desejável familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento, versionamento e ticketing (como Movidesk Git, Zabbix, Freshdesk, etc.).
  • Capacidade de estruturar scripts e automações simples para análise e correção de dados (ex: Python, Shell Script).


Habilidades Pessoais Esperadas:

  • Proatividade e postura investigativa , com senso de urgência na resolução de problemas.
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva, com capacidade de explicar temas técnicos para públicos diversos.
  • Relacionamento fluido com clientes, sabendo equilibrar empatia, transparência e firmeza.
  • Organização, autonomia e comprometimento com prazos e entregas.
  • Espírito colaborativo, trabalhando bem com diferentes áreas e níveis de suporte (N1, Produto, Dev, etc.).


Mais informações:

  • Nossa contratação é como Prestador de serviços, então se faz necessário ter um CNPJ ativo.

title: Assistant Project Manager
description:
International Countertop Consultants (ICC) is growing! We are currently looking to hire a detail-oriented and organized Assistant Project Manager. The Assistant Project Manager will work with our Project Manager on the planning, coordination, and completion of projects.

A little about ICC: 

ICC is a dynamic and rapidly growing company that specializes in providing competitive commercial granite and quartz countertop and cabinet solutions, including both supply and installation, for multi-family projects across the United States.


While we currently operate with a lean and highly dedicated team, this is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing organization poised for exponential expansion over the next few years. We're looking for someone who’s excited to grow alongside us.


With over 25 years of global industry experience, ICC has built strong international relationships and successfully completed installations in more than 265,000 units nationwide. Our CEO is a founding member of the Rockhead Group, a national alliance of top fabricators representing approximately $1.4 billion in combined annual sales.


At ICC, our culture is the foundation of everything we do. We’re driven by a shared set of core values that shape how we work and who we hire. We believe in authenticity and integrity, always leading with honesty and trust. Innovation and continuous improvement keep us moving forward, while global collaboration allows us to build strong, diverse partnerships. We approach challenges with tenacity and grit, take pride in delivering excellence, and always keep our customers at the center of our decisions. Above all, we value critical thinking and creative problem-solving, empowering our team to ask the right questions and drive meaningful results. These values guide how we build our team, and they’re the standard by which we hire, recognize, and grow.

Job Description:

  • Support the PM with the coordination of multiple projects to ensure they are completed on time and on budget
  • Assist with completing RFI’s, Change Orders, Punch List/Post Walks, AIA/Billing, Close Out Docs
  • Organize and document project tasks and schedules
  • Communicate project status to stakeholders and key project participants
  • Responsible for overseeing, management and administration of our PM software Procore
  • Coordinate Weekly Reporting to Contractors
  • Maintain Project Specific Insurance, Worker’s Comp, Safety Documents
  • Create presentations and reports to communicate project status
  • Draft Subcontractor Subcontracts

Requirements & Qualifications:

  • Strong construction background (countertops/cabinets preferred)
  • Previous APM or similar role experience
  • Tech/computer savvy (quick to learn new systems)
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Excellent English and communication skills (able to work with subs, GCs, clients, and team members)
  • Detail-oriented with strong attention to detail
  • Critical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to read drawings
  • Knowledge of AIA documents
  • Availability to work 7am-3pm EST


Compensation ranges from $7–$15 per hour, depending on experience and location. In addition, we offer paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays as part of our benefits package.

Prezensa, uma empresa de tecnologia com foco em pessoas e compromisso real com resultados.

PostgreSQL e MySQL;

Git;

Modularização e organização de código;

CI/CD para pipelines de integração e entrega contínua, automatizando testes;

Builds e deploys, para garantia da agilidade e confiabilidade.

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!


MoveUp Media

title: Consultor Oracle
description:
Consultor Oracle Retail Planning – IPO

Local de Trabalho: México (100% remoto)

Data de Início: Imediata

Duração Prevista: 3 a 4 meses

Horário: 9h00 as 18h00 (Horário México)

Idioma: Espanhol Avançado


Visão geral da posição


Buscamos um(a) Consultor(a) Oracle Retail com forte experiência em ferramentas de planejamento, especialmente Oracle Retail IPO (Inventory Planning Optimization), para atuação em projeto internacional do segmento de varejo. O profissional atuará em nível sênior, com responsabilidade técnica e funcional, apoiando decisões de arquitetura, desenho de solução e alinhamento com áreas de negócio e tecnologia.


Principais responsabilidades


• Atuar como arquiteto técnico-funcional em soluções de planejamento dentro do ecossistema Oracle Retail

• Liderar o desenho de soluções utilizando Oracle Retail IPO e módulos relacionados a planejamento e reposição

• Traduzir requisitos de negócio do varejo em configurações e soluções funcionais e técnicas

• Apoiar decisões de arquitetura, integrações e fluxos de dados entre sistemas corporativos

• Conduzir workshops com áreas de negócio, especialmente planejamento de demanda, estoque e supply chain

• Garantir aderência às melhores práticas de Oracle Retail Planning

• Apoiar testes funcionais, validações de negócio e entrada em produção

• Atuar como referência técnica para o time do projeto e stakeholders internacionais


Requisitos técnicos obrigatórios


• Experiência sólida com Oracle Retail Planning

• Experiência comprovada com Oracle Retail IPO (Inventory Planning Optimization)

• Vivência em projetos de varejo (Retail), preferencialmente em ambientes complexos e multinacionais

• Experiência em papel de arquiteto ou líder técnico-funcional

• Conhecimento de processos de planejamento de estoque, reposição e otimização de inventário

• Experiência com integrações entre soluções Oracle Retail e outros sistemas corporativos

• Capacidade de atuação tanto funcional quanto técnica (perfil híbrido)


Idiomas


• Espanhol avançado obrigatório (interação frequente com time e stakeholders do México)

• Inglês intermediário ou superior desejável


Diferenciais


• Experiência prévia em projetos cloud no ecossistema Oracle

• Vivência em ambientes com múltiplos países ou operações de varejo de grande porte

• Conhecimento de outros módulos Oracle Retail Planning (como RDF, AIP ou similares)


Soft skills esperadas


• Comunicação clara e estruturada com áreas técnicas e de negócio

• Capacidade de conduzir discussões funcionais com foco em solução

• Perfil colaborativo e orientado a resultados

• Autonomia e senso de responsabilidade em ambiente remoto

• Facilidade para atuar em contexto multicultural e internacional

• Pensamento analítico para resolução de problemas complexos


Maiores detalhes serão fornecidos durante entrevista técnica com o cliente.

title: Applied Scientist
description:
Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML – Pricing)

We are looking for a highly accomplished Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML) with a strong research background and deep expertise in machine learning to develop and deploy advanced pricing and price optimization solutions. This role requires a combination of research excellence and hands-on production experience, translating complex real-world business problems into scalable machine learning systems.

This opportunity is ideal for professionals passionate about applied research, advanced machine learning, and delivering high-impact AI solutions at scale.


Key Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop advanced machine learning and statistical models for pricing and price optimization.
  • Translate complex business problems into mathematical and algorithmic solutions.
  • Analyze large, complex datasets to generate actionable insights and improve pricing strategies.
  • Build, validate, and deploy scalable ML/DL models in production environments.
  • Apply advanced techniques including optimization, forecasting, and causal inference.
  • Develop clean, efficient, and production-grade code.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver data-driven solutions and deployable products.
  • Contribute to intellectual property through research publications and conference presentations.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentor junior team members.


Required Qualifications (Mandatory)

  • PhD or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field.
  • Proven research background with publications in recognized scientific journals
  • Experience presenting research at industry or academic conferences
  • 5+ years of experience in applied Machine Learning
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML/DL models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices including experiment design, A/B testing, feature engineering, and training/serving pipelines
  • Hands-on experience with ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, or Keras
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL
  • Experience working with large-scale datasets and data engineering workflows
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure )


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience applying ML to pricing, optimization, forecasting, recommender systems, personalization, computer vision, fraud detection, or marketing analytics
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and ML lifecycle management
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
  • Demonstrated leadership or mentoring experience

  • Analyze large, complex datasets to generate actionable insights and improve pricing strategies.
  • Build, validate, and deploy scalable ML/DL models in production environments.
  • Apply advanced techniques including optimization, forecasting, and causal inference.
  • Develop clean, efficient, and production-grade code.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver data-driven solutions and deployable products.
  • Contribute to intellectual property through research publications and conference presentations.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentor junior team members.


Required Qualifications (Mandatory)

  • PhD or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field.
  • Proven research background with publications in recognized scientific journals
  • Experience presenting research at industry or academic conferences
  • 5+ years of experience in applied Machine Learning
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML/DL models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices including experiment design, A/B testing, feature engineering, and training/serving pipelines
  • Hands-on experience with ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, or Keras
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL
  • Experience working with large-scale datasets and data engineering workflows
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure )


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience applying ML to pricing, optimization, forecasting, recommender systems, personalization, computer vision, fraud detection, or marketing analytics
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and ML lifecycle management
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
  • Demonstrated leadership or mentoring experience

title: Engenheiro de Dados
description:
Sobre a Volpi

Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário . Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais . Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!


O desafio

Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.

Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.

Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership , tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
  • Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
  • Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance ;
  • Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
  • Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
  • Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
  • Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
  • Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida como Data Engineer , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
  • Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
  • Experiência prática com AWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
  • Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) ;
  • Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
  • Forte preocupação com segurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Experiência em ambientes de startup , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
  • Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
  • Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.


Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
  • Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
  • Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
  • Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.



Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Modelo remoto prioritário
  • Plano de saúde Alice (100% pago para titular e dependentes)
  • R$600/ano para infraestrutura de home office
  • R$1.000/ano de auxílio educação
  • 30 dias de descanso remunerado + 10 dias de recesso de fim de ano
  • Day off no aniversário
  • TotalPass (incluindo TotalMind)
  • Acesso ao Wework
  • Encontros presenciais para troca e conexão com a nossa Tribo
